evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No pre-adoption comparison is included; observations begin at adoption.
evidenceCoverage.reason: No comparable pre-adoption outcome evaluation is established for this contract.

caveat: The evidence measures post-adoption attainment only; without a comparable pre-adoption baseline it cannot establish improvement or causation.

intent.goal: Keep the workflow designer synchronized with authoritative aw reference documents.
intent.acceptance: Every reported drift item independently resolved, all seven source audit categories accurate, no false positive drift assertions.

evidence.opportunity: Distinct explicitly written repository-local documentation references repaired from a nonexistent file to an existing file in a native parent/child transition. Separately: Count only explicit new invalid-shorthand-to-valid-ecosystem table mappings whose exact pair is independently specified in contemporaneous network reference documentation, or new safe-output mapping cells whose exact output name is both a workflow-schema property and a registered safe-output operation. Before source must lack that mapping. Require stable authoritative pair/key at both native parent and child. Mentioning a runtime operation absent from schema does not qualify.
filters: Parent and child workflow source must both contain the designer synchronization goal and stale-reference audit.
Historical fixed-reference assessment authored before native outcome inspection; not ex-ante adoption measurement.

Outcome-informed retrospective authoring: frozen after source reading and bounded candidate PR prose describing repairs, before inspecting immutable native before/after contents or oracle results. Not blind, ex-ante, adopted at the historical workflow date, or backdated acceptance. Candidate prose is untrusted and does not establish native outcomes.
evidence.collection: Replay hash-verified original Git objects with a deterministic local-reference oracle. Bounded selected cases are not exhaustive history.

model.architecture: Original source and parent/child trees -> explicit reference transitions -> native interval quantities
model.recommendation: Not rated; no native keep bar or cost evidence.
